description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pussella, Redeegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420089
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including details about land ownership, extent, location (village, district, cadastral maps), and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
